prompt: Original pixel-art game sprite source sheet, three distinct adult NPC identities stacked vertically with generous spacing and a dark neutral background. For EACH identity make a clean 4 by 4 grid: rows are front-facing, back-facing, left-facing, right-facing; columns are four distinct walk-cycle phases with alternating feet and natural arm swing. Use crisp hand-authored 16-bit pixel art, hard pixel edges, limited cohesive palette, no text, no UI, no shadows outside the sprites, no duplicate poses, consistent scale within each identity. This is an original design for a life-simulation game, not based on any existing franchise or asset.
